name: Vale of Eternity: Curse
source: Card and Summoner text read from the card and tile images on valeofeternity.wiki.gg (Curse Expansion page, 2026-10-25). Rules: the Curse rulebook (Mandoo Games / Renegade Game Studios, 2025), photos on the same page.

typeHelp.front_permanent: Always on while this side is up.
typeHelp.front_active: Once per round, during the Resolution Phase.
typeHelp.back_permanent: Always on while this side is up.
typeHelp.back_active: Once per round, during the Resolution Phase.

list.emptyText: Pick your Summoner in the Summoners tab.

reminders: Wards: when you summon a card or pay to remove one, you may break exactly 1 active :ward: to pay 2 of the cost. Never for other payments.
Mend: turn a :ward_broken: active again. With all wards active, remove one of your :curse: instead.
A cursed card that is discarded sends its :curse: back to the supply; one taken into a hand (Recover) puts them on that player.
Summoner tiles flip whenever their :flip: condition is met; that is mandatory. They are not cards, so card effects (Genie…) don't touch them.
Final score: −2 per :curse: on you or your cards, +1 per active :ward: and per soothed card. These don't count toward the 60-point game end.

how: With Curse: shuffle its 28 cards into the draw pile too (98 in all).

checklist.text: Tree standee and all Curse tokens next to the supply
Each player takes 3 Ward tokens, active side up
Pick Summoners: the last player first, then counterclockwise
checklist.sub: First games: Varena, Iwo, Belledin or Marcosa. Kang San needs the Artifacts expansion.

checklist.text: Summoner on its starting side; take what it shows
checklist.sub: Its Curse tokens and extras (Iwo, Tolvar: wards broken; Varena: draw 1; Kang San: shelter 2). Add it to Summoner in the app after the new game.

how: With Curse, Summoner effects that say "at the start of the round" happen first (Marcosa, Muura, Tolvar).
WARD: when summoning or paying to remove, you may break 1 active :ward: to pay 2 of the cost.
SUMMON a card with :curse_symbol: printed on it: after paying, put that many :curse: on it, resolve Permanent effects the summon triggers, then its Instant effect.
Your Summoner's Active effect resolves in this phase too, once.

children.title: Curse
children.summary: Move 1 curse token from each of your cursed cards onto yourself.
children.emptyText: No cursed cards in your Field. Nothing to move.
how: All players at once. From each of your cursed cards, move one :curse: onto yourself, in any order.
The last :curse: off a card soothes it: place it face down under your Summoner tile. It frees its space and is worth 1 :points: at the end. In the app, drag it to Soothed.
Cards without a printed :curse_symbol: can carry tokens too (Tyr, Dunia): they count the same.
Final score with Curse: −2 per :curse: on you and your cards, +1 per active :ward: and per soothed card.

checklist.text: Game over? Score curses, wards and soothed cards
checklist.sub: −2 per :curse:, +1 per active :ward: and soothed card
